sponsored.t: Relates to certain rates of payment for services provided by assisted living programs
sponsored.sum: Provides that such rates of payment shall be updated to reflect the most current mean price for free-standing residential health care facilities with less than three hundred beds each time that the cost basis of residential health care facility rates is updated.
sponsored.fis: Positive to the State. Since assisted living programs, which serve nurs- ing home eligible patients, are paid fifty percent of the nursing home rate, updating their payment rates will generate savings to the State by avoiding more costly placements and will prevent programs from closing.

sponsored.t: Requires all public and private schools to provide financial literacy education to certain pupils
sponsored.sum: Requires all public and private schools to provide financial literacy education to pupils in grade eleven; directs that certain topics be covered in such educational program.

sponsored.t: Provides for income access services in the state
sponsored.sum: Provides for the licensing and regulation of income access services in the state.

sponsored.t: Establishes an online database identifying regional skills and employment gaps and the skills and training needed to fill open and anticipated jobs
sponsored.sum: Directs the commissioner of labor to establish an online database identifying regional skills and employment gaps and the skills and training needed to fill open and anticipated jobs.

sponsored.t: Creates the fourteenth judicial district consisting of the county of Monroe
sponsored.sum: Creates the fourteenth judicial district consisting of the county of Monroe; provides for continuation of the seventh judicial district and the positions of certain seventh and fourteenth judicial district justices; makes related provisions.

sponsored.t: Relates to enacting the "ghostbuster act"
sponsored.sum: Enhances enforcement of laws requiring proper and readable license plates and vehicle identification numbers; increases penalties including booting.

sponsored.t: Relates photo speed violation monitoring systems in a highway construction or maintenance work area; makes permanent
sponsored.sum: Increases the number of photo speed violation monitoring systems in a highway construction or maintenance work area; makes such provisions permanent.

sponsored.t: Fines imposed for failure to move over
sponsored.sum: Imposes fines for failure to exercise due care and move over when approaching parked, stopped or standing motor vehicles on the shoulder of a highway.

sponsored.t: Includes fuel-flexible linear generators which do not utilize a fossil fuel resource in the process of generating electricity as qualifying as renewable energy systems
sponsored.sum: Includes fuel-flexible linear generators which do not utilize a fossil fuel resource in the process of generating electricity as qualifying as renewable energy systems.

sponsored.t: Enacts the interchange fee prohibition act
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "interchange fee prohibition act"; prohibits the receipt or charge of interchange fees on the tax amount or gratuity of an electronic payment transaction if the merchant informs the acquirer bank or its designee of the tax or gratuity amount as part of the authorization or settlement process for the electronic payment transaction; establishes penalties.

sponsored.t: Relates to aggravated unlicensed operation of a motor vehicle in the first degree
sponsored.sum: Provides that a person is guilty of aggravated unlicensed operation of a motor vehicle in the first degree when such person commits the offense of aggravated unlicensed operation of a motor vehicle in the third degree and causes the death or serious physical injury of another person.

sponsored.t: Establishes a fixed fee for the purchase of registration lists and title information
sponsored.sum: Provides that the commissioner of motor vehicles shall affix a cost for the sale of registration lists and title information or other records in bulk at the annual cost not to exceed $1,520,000; authorizes such commissioner to impose other requirements; makes related provisions.
sponsored.fis: The adoption of this bill ensures that existing DMV fees are set in statute, providing a consistent revenue stream to the State while adding clarity to the bidding process.

sponsored.t: Postpones the implementation and enforcement of the advanced clean trucks regulations
sponsored.sum: Postpones the implementation and enforcement of the advanced clean trucks regulations by the department of environmental conservation.
sponsored.fis: This bill will have no fiscal impacts on state or local governments.

sponsored.t: Provides for money upon release for certain incarcerated individuals; appropriation
sponsored.sum: Establishes the reentry assistance program; provides for eligible incarcerated individuals to receive a monthly stipend upon release from a state correctional facility; makes an appropriation of $25,000,000.
sponsored.fis: $25,000,000 appropriated from the state's general fund to the Reentry Assistance Program

sponsored.t: Relates to advanced recycling and advanced recycling facilities
sponsored.sum: Relates to advanced recycling and advanced recycling facilities.

sponsored.t: Relates to the definition of small business for minority group members and women with respect to state contracts
sponsored.sum: Increases the number of persons from three hundred to five hundred to be considered a small business for the purposes of MWBE.

sponsored.t: Transportation services for certain school districts
sponsored.sum: Relates to transportation services for the school districts of the cities of Buffalo, Rochester, Syracuse and Yonkers.

sponsored.t: Relates to insurance coverage for medical marihuana
sponsored.sum: Relates to providing insurance coverage for medical marihuana.
sponsored.fis: To be determined to the extent medical marijuana displaces other prescription drugs, there could be substantial savings.

sponsored.t: Relates to owner liability for failure of operator to stop at a stop sign or yield for a pedestrian as required by law in the counties of Monroe and Onondaga
sponsored.sum: Relates to owner liability for failure of operator to stop at a stop sign or yield for a pedestrian as required by law in any municipality in the counties of Monroe and Onondaga; provides that such demonstration program shall empower such municipality to install and operate stop sign and pedestrian crossing photo violation monitoring systems which may be stationary or mobile, and which may be installed within the boundaries of such municipality; makes related provisions.

sponsored.t: Establishes central depository databases for governmental real property transaction records and data
sponsored.sum: Establishes central depository databases at the state and county levels for governmental real property transaction records and data.
sponsored.fis: The legislation will require an initial investment by the governmental entity to establish usage of blockchain. However, once implemented, savings will be realized almost immediately as the process becomes more efficient. Transactions will be less cumbersome and require a signif- icant reduction in staff time to finalize the transactions. In instances where there exists paper storage, that need can be eliminated resulting in additional fiscal savings. Lastly, and very significantly, the secu- rity provided by the blockchain will not only produce monetary savings, as theft and fraud will be eliminated, but it will save individuals from the distress of being a victim of these devasting crimes.

sponsored.t: Expands eligibility for participation in the pre-licensing course internet pilot program
sponsored.sum: Expands eligibility for participation in the pre-licensing course internet pilot program; extends such provisions of law from June 30, 2025 to June 30, 2030.
sponsored.fis: There are no fiscal impacts to the State.

sponsored.t: Relates to the sale of cannabinoid hemp products
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the sale of cannabinoid hemp products where the ratio of CBD to THC exceeds a 15:1 ratio.

sponsored.t: Relates to owner liability for failure to stop at a stop sign or yield for a pedestrian
sponsored.sum: Authorizes a municipality to adopt a local law or ordinance to establish a program imposing monetary liability on the owner of a vehicle for failure of an operator to install and operate stop sign and pedestrian crossing photo violation monitoring systems.

sponsored.t: Relates to wage reporting in the unemployment insurance law
sponsored.sum: Provides that to achieve cost savings to businesses and the state, improve decision timeliness, and minimize wrong-sized payments to eligible beneficiaries the department of labor shall obtain current employment and income information from a third-party provider, supplementing current state wage reporting files from the department of taxation and finance.

sponsored.t: Relates to student financial aid programs
sponsored.sum: Relates to student financial aid programs; allows absence because of uniformed service, maternity/paternity, FMLA, or due to compensable injury to be creditable time.

sponsored.t: Establishes under the direction of the state board of pharmacy a drug repository program
sponsored.sum: Establishes under the direction of the state board of pharmacy a drug repository program to accept and dispense donated prescription drugs; authorizes such board and the commissioner of health to promulgate rules and regulations; makes definitions; exempts such persons or entities who dispense such donated drugs from criminal or tort liability or professional disciplinary action.

sponsored.t: Relates to operation of an all-terrain vehicle by a minor on public or private property
sponsored.sum: Relates to operation of an all-terrain vehicle by a minor on public or private property; requires a helmet on private and public property.

sponsored.t: Relates to the New York state district attorney and indigent legal services attorney loan forgiveness program
sponsored.sum: Relates to the New York state district attorney and indigent legal services attorney loan forgiveness program; allows absence because of uniformed service, maternity/paternity, FMLA, or due to compensable injury to be creditable time.

sponsored.t: Relates to used motor vehicle dealer education
sponsored.sum: Establishes used motor vehicle dealer training programs to educate dealers on topics such as consumer protection and sales and use tax collection; permits trade organizations to apply to conduct training programs.

sponsored.t: Requiring that vehicles yield the right of way to multi-use trails that cross roadways
sponsored.sum: Requires that vehicles yield the right of way to multi-use trails that cross roadways.

sponsored.t: Allows the use of unmanned aerial vehicles in tracking big game
sponsored.sum: Allows the use of unmanned aerial vehicles in tracking big game that are dead, wounded or injured.

sponsored.t: Provides that any service outside of a city with a population of more than one million, that is designated as a microtransit service shall be eligible for statewide mass transportation operating assistance regard
sponsored.sum: Provides that any service outside of a city with a population of more than one million, that is designated as a microtransit service shall be eligible for statewide mass transportation operating assistance regardless of vehicle size; defines "microtransit service" to mean a technology-enabled on-demand service with dynamically generated routing that uses a managed fleet of multi-passenger vehicles dedicated to that service.

sponsored.t: Requires police reports of traffic accidents to include insurance information for the parties to the accident
sponsored.sum: Requires police reports of traffic accidents to include insurance information for the parties to the accident.

sponsored.t: Relates to certain criminal penalties for driving while impaired by alcohol or drugs
sponsored.sum: Relates to certain criminal penalties involving required alcohol and drug rehabilitation for driving while impaired by alcohol or drugs.

sponsored.t: Enacts "Shawn's law"
sponsored.sum: Enacts "Shawn's law"; requires persons driving on a state expressway route, state interstate route, or state thruway route to pull over and seek assistance if their vehicle is unable to exceed thirty-five miles per hour; requires the division of state police to conduct an accident reconstruction and create a report in the case of certain accidents resulting in a fatality.

sponsored.t: Establishes the crimes of spoofing a police agency telephone number in the first and second degrees as a class E felony and a class A misdemeanor
sponsored.sum: Establishes the crimes of spoofing a police agency telephone number in the first and second degrees as a class E felony and a class A misdemeanor.

sponsored.t: Provides for exceptions to the ban on night riding
sponsored.sum: Exempts horse-drawn carriages or carts from the ban on night riding if they display at least two lighted lamps on the front of the vehicle, one on each side, having light sources of equal power and visible from the front for a distance of at least three hundred fifty feet; at least one lighted lamp on the rear, located between the center and the left side of the vehicle, which shall display a red or amber fixed or flashing light visible from a distance of at least five hundred feet; and reflective material upon the shafts of the vehicle or other parts thereof which shall normally parallel the body, head or legs of the horse pulling such vehicle.

sponsored.t: Relates to the completion of and information contained in heating, ventilation and air conditioning systems assessments as part of building condition surveys for purposes of grant eligibility
sponsored.sum: Relates to the completion of and information contained in heating, ventilation and air conditioning systems assessments as part of building condition surveys for purposes of grant eligibility; requires such assessments to include a report containing specific information and includes qualification requirements for the person completing the report.
sponsored.fis: Recurring funding, indexed for inflation, is currently allocated for the completion of Building Condition Surveys.

sponsored.t: Relates to number stickers for motor vehicles
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the commissioner of motor vehicles to develop and offer number stickers to be used on motor vehicles in the place of number plates.

sponsored.t: Relates to a conditional adult-use retail dispensary license
sponsored.sum: Provides for minimum requirements for a conditional adult-use retail dispensary license.
sponsored.fis: Enactment of this legislation would protect the collective millions of dollars in private investments that CAURD licensees have made in their businesses.

sponsored.t: Relates to school bus stop-arm cameras
sponsored.sum: Relates to school bus stop-arm cameras; makes technical amendments thereto.

sponsored.t: Encourages school districts to prioritize civic organizations which encourage community for students in allowing outside groups to use school facilities
sponsored.sum: Encourages school districts to give opportunities to students by giving priority to outside groups which encourage community for students to use school facilities.

sponsored.t: Increases the weight limits for vehicles powered primarily by electric battery power and other fuels
sponsored.sum: Provides that a vehicle or a combination of vehicles operated by an engine fueled primarily by means of natural gas, propane gas, or hydrogen or powered primarily by means of electric battery power may exceed certain weight limits by up to two thousand pounds.

sponsored.t: Requires the disclosure of tariff cost estimates in automobile sales
sponsored.sum: Requires the disclosure of tariff cost estimates in automobile sales by affixing such to the car window in a clear, conspicuous, and easily understandable manner; provides such requirement can be satisfied by including it on the Monroney label.

sponsored.t: Relates to a tax credit for the purchase of new and used electric vehicles
sponsored.sum: Establishes a tax credit for the purchase of new and used electric cars; provides that for a new electric vehicle, the tax credit shall be $7,500 and the tax credit for a used electric vehicle shall be $4,000.

sponsored.t: Adds assault of certain transportation workers to assault in the second degree
sponsored.sum: Adds assault of a highway worker, motor vehicle investigator and motor vehicle inspector to the crime of assault in the second degree; defines such terms.

sponsored.t: Grants retroactive tier II membership in the New York state and local police and fire retirement system to Daniel Rizzo
sponsored.sum: Grants retroactive tier II membership in the New York state and local police and fire retirement system to Daniel Rizzo.
sponsored.fis: All past services costs associated with the implementation of this act shall be borne by the state.

sponsored.t: Imposes limits on where licensed adult use dispensing facilities may be located and waivers from such proximity protection
sponsored.sum: Provides that licensed adult use dispensing facilities shall be no less than 1,000 feet apart in municipalities with a population of 20,000 people or more, and no less than 2,000 feet apart in municipalities with a population of less than 20,000 people; provides proximity protection waivers.

sponsored.t: Extends the expiration of provisions relating to the estate tax treatment of dispositions for certain surviving spouses
sponsored.sum: Extends the effectiveness of the estate tax treatment of dispositions to surviving spouses who are not United States citizens to July 1, 2028.

sponsored.t: Relates to warranties and sales incentives
sponsored.sum: Requires every franchisor, including its affiliates and subsidiaries to properly fulfill any warranty agreement and/or franchisor's service contract and to compensate each of its franchised motor vehicle dealers for warranty parts and labor, including but not limited to all warranty repairs, extended service contract repairs, extended warranty repairs, campaigns, service bulletins, policy repairs, component part warranties, factory compensated repairs, recalls, diagnostics, parts and other voluntary stop-sell repairs, and any other franchisor compensated repairs; relates to reimbursement to a motor vehicle dealer from a motor vehicle franchisor.

sponsored.t: Relates to cannabinoid hemp beverages
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "hemp beverage and taxation act"; defines cannabinoid hemp beverage; prohibits the sale of cannabinoid hemp beverages to persons twenty-one years of age or older; provides requirements for the product or labeling of such products; provides for offenses for persons under the age of twenty-one years who purchase or attempt to purchase a cannabinoid hemp beverage through fraudulent means and persons who procure such beverages for persons under the age of twenty-one years; imposes advertising requirements; imposes a tax on cannabinoid hemp products; provides for the disbursement of revenues collected pursuant to Article 20-e of the Tax Law.
sponsored.fis: This bill will have no fiscal impact on the State or local governments, the proposal will provide a new tax, creating an estimated $50+ million in new revenue to the State.

sponsored.t: Directs the superintendent of state police develop a critical incident policy for members of the state police
sponsored.sum: Requires the superintendent of state police to develop, maintain and disseminate to all members of the division of state police a critical incident leave policy requiring critical incident paid leave for any members directly involved in a critical incident; prohibits such superintendent from taking any punitive administrative action against any member of the division of state police granted critical incident leave solely on the basis of the provision of such leave.

veto.text: VETO MESSAGE - No. 138 TO THE SENATE: I am returning herewith, without my approval, the following bill: Senate Bill Number 2681-B, entitled: "AN ACT to amend the executive law, in relation to the development of a critical incident policy for members of the division of state police" NOT APPROVED This bill would mandate a Critical Incident Leave policy for the Divi- sion of State Police, requiring twenty days of critical incident leave for a Trooper who causes death or serious physical injury and fifteen days of critical incident leave for any other Trooper involved in the incident. The goal of supporting the mental health of Troopers involved in crit- ical incidents is important and well-intentioned. However, the bill applies a fixed leave policy to situations that can vary significantly. In some cases, more than twenty days may be appropriate; in others, less may be sufficient. The bill…

sponsored.t: Relates to prohibiting the procurement of certain technology and products which pose a state or national security risk
sponsored.sum: Aligns state and local procurement laws with federal law prohibiting the procurement of certain information and communications technology and electronic parts or products which are determined to pose a risk to state and national security.

appr.text: APPROVAL MEMORANDUM - No. 63 Chapter 683 MEMORANDUM filed with Senate Bill Number 3259, entitled: "AN ACT to amend the state finance law and the general municipal law, in relation to prohibiting procurement of certain technolo- gy that poses security threats" APPROVED This bill would aim to ensure that any technology procured by the State of New York, or any locality would not pose a security threat. I am committed to ensuring that any technology procurement by a state or local government meets the utmost safety standards so that sensitive information is not subject to an attack. The bill, however, has several issues that required addressing before I could support. I have reached an agreement with the legislature to address these issues through amendment of the bill. The amendments will ensure that any government procurement undergoes review led by the Office of Infor- mation Technology…

sponsored.t: Allows for individuals to consent to receive information regarding donor programs at the time of application for or renewal of a driver's license or non-driver identification card
sponsored.sum: Allows for individuals consent to receive information from the C.W. Bill Young Cell Transplantation Program and the national marrow donor program at the time of application for or renewal of a driver's license or non-driver identification card; directs the commissioner of motor vehicles to establish a process by which the department of motor vehicles shall refer driver's license and non-driver identification card applicants who consent to having their information shared with the C.W. Bill Young Cell Transplantation Program and the national marrow donor program for the purposes of receiving information from such programs about enrolling as a potential donor.
sponsored.fis: None. This act shall take effect January 1, 2028. Effective immediately, the addition, amendment and/or repeal of any rule or regulation necessary for the implementation of this act on its effective date are authorized be made and completed on or before such date.

sponsored.t: Relates to the timeframe for distributors of cannabis products to file tax returns
sponsored.sum: Relates to the timeframe for distributors of cannabis products to file tax returns.
sponsored.fis: This legislation will have no annual fiscal implications. While the time period of paying the cannabis excise tax may be adjusted, the tax will still be paid in full.

veto.text: VETO MESSAGE - No. 97 TO THE SENATE: I am returning herewith, without my approval, the following bill: Senate Bill Number 8091, entitled: "AN ACT to amend the tax law, in relation to the timeframe of distributors of cannabis products to file tax returns" NOT APPROVED This bill would amend the tax law to modify the filing timeframe for tax returns submitted by distributors and cannabis product manufactur- ers. This misalignment would create considerable…

sponsored.t: Allows pharmacy technicians to practice in any pharmacy under the supervision of a pharmacist
sponsored.sum: Allows pharmacy technicians to practice in any pharmacy under the supervision of a pharmacist.

sponsored.t: Relating to medical use of cannabis and to the controlled substances therapeutic research act; repealer
sponsored.sum: Relates to the medical use of cannabis; repeals controlled substances therapeutic research act.

sponsored.t: Relates to certain bonds issued to finance school rehabilitation or reconstruction costs for Rochester schools
sponsored.sum: Relates to calculation of interests costs for certain bonds issued to finance school rehabilitation or reconstruction costs for Rochester schools.
sponsored.fis: Total cost to the State and Local government to be determined.

sponsored.t: Relates to professional employer organization services
sponsored.sum: Provides that receipts from other services and other business receipts, taxpayers, and combined groups including members, engaged in providing professional employer organization services shall include with such receipts amounts received with respect to wages, benefits, and other employee expenses disbursed to or for the benefit of a client's worksite employees and the related employment taxes if the amounts received are included in the calculation of the business income base or the combined business income base, respectively.

sponsored.t: Relates to the Rochester school facilities modernization program act
sponsored.sum: Authorizes an additional $125 million for Phase 3 of the Rochester school facilities modernization program; extends phase 3 of the Rochester school facilities modernization program to 2033.
sponsored.fis: Total cost to the State and Local government to be determined. This legislation authorizes construction up to $600 million for the proposed Phase III Strategic Plan.

sponsored.t: Relates to the use of virtual credit cards by insurers and certain health care plans
sponsored.sum: Authorizes an insurer to pay a claim for reimbursement made by a provider using a credit card, virtual credit card or electronic funds transfer payment method that imposes on the provider a free or similar charge to process the payment; defines "virtual credit card" as a single-use series of numbers linked to a fixed dollar amount and provided by an insurer to a provider for the purpose of paying a claim for health care services performed by the provider; makes related provisions.

sponsored.t: Directs the commissioner of motor vehicles to conduct a study of official inspection stations, safety inspections and fees
sponsored.sum: Directs the commissioner of motor vehicles to conduct a study to examine and update the requirements of safety inspections conducted to ensure the operational safety of all motor vehicles; requires a report; makes related provisions.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the county of Monroe to offer an optional twenty year retirement plan to Christopher R. Fay
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the county of Monroe to offer an optional twenty year retirement plan to Christopher R. Fay, a deputy sheriff employed by the county of Monroe.
sponsored.fis: If this bill is enacted during the 2025 Legislative Session, we antic- ipate that there will be an increase of approximately $14,000 in the annual contributions of Monroe County for the fiscal year ending March 31, 2026. In future years this cost will vary as the billing rates and salary of Christopher R. Fay change. In addition to the annual contrib- utions discussed above, there will be an immediate past service cost of approximately $153,000 which will be borne by Monroe County as a onetime payment. This estimate assumes that payment will be made on February 1, 2026. If Monroe County elects to amortize this cost over a five-year period, the cost for each year including interest would be $34,200.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the county of Monroe to offer an optional twenty year retirement plan to Gregory M. Prokop
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the county of Monroe to offer an optional twenty year retirement plan to Gregory M. Prokop, a deputy sheriff/investigator employed by the county of Monroe.
sponsored.fis: If this bill is enacted during the 2025 Legislative Session, we antic- ipate that there will be an increase of approximately $13,000 in the annual contributions of Monroe County for the fiscal year ending March 31, 2026. In future years this cost will vary as the billing rates and salary of Gregory M. Prokop change. In addition to the annual contrib- utions discussed above, there will be an immediate past service cost of approximately $141,000 which will be borne by Monroe County as a onetime payment. This estimate assumes that payment will be made on February 1, 2026. If Monroe County elects to amortize this cost over a five-year period, the cost for each year including interest would be $31,600.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the county of Monroe to offer an optional twenty year retirement plan to Carl J. Zimmerman
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the county of Monroe to offer an optional twenty year retirement plan to Carl J. Zimmerman, a deputy sheriff employed by the county of Monroe.
sponsored.fis: If this bill is enacted during the 2025 Legislative Session, we antic- ipate that there will be an increase of approximately $13,000 in the annual contributions of Monroe County for the fiscal year ending March 31, 2026. In future years this cost will vary as the billing rates and salary of Carl J. Zimmerman change. In addition to the annual contrib- utions discussed above, there will be an immediate past service cost of approximately $120,000 which will be borne by Monroe County as a onetime payment. This estimate assumes that payment will be made on February 1, 2026. If Monroe County elects to amortize this cost over a five-year period, the cost for each year including interest would be $26,800.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the granting of retirement service credit in the optional twenty year retirement plan to Duane A. Palma for service as a correction officer
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the granting of retirement service credit in the optional twenty year retirement plan to Duane A. Palma for service as a correction officer at the Monroe county sheriff's office jail bureau.
sponsored.fis: If this bill is enacted during the 2025 Legislative Session, there will be an immediate past service cost of approximately $160,000 which will be borne by Monroe County as a one-time payment. This estimate assumes that payment will be made on February 1, 2026. If Monroe County elects to amortize this cost over a five-year period, the cost for each year including interest would be $35,900.

sponsored.t: Relates to consumer litigation funding
sponsored.sum: Enacts the consumer litigation funding act to promote consumer protections related to consumer litigation funding transactions; provides for contract requirements, including that the contract contain a no penalty provision for the prepayment of the funded amount prior to the settlement of their case; makes related provisions.

sponsored.t: Relates to preferred source status for entities that provide employment to certain persons
sponsored.sum: Includes entities that provide employment or services to formerly incarcerated persons in the preferred source exemption for purposes of state purchasing.

sponsored.t: Relates to fines for false alarms by an alarm system
sponsored.sum: Relates to fines for false alarms by an alarm system; allows a municipality to enact, adopt or enforce any ordinance, resolution or regulation requiring any alarm system company to pay for or be responsible for any fines, fees or other penalties relative to false alarms only when the false alarm is attributed to a deficiency in the alarm system or an error of the alarm system company or central station.

sponsored.t: Extends the effectiveness of article 19-b of the real property actions and proceedings law providing for special proceedings to convey title to abandoned commercial and industrial real property
sponsored.sum: Extends the effectiveness of provisions providing for special proceedings to convey title to abandoned commercial and industrial real property to a city, town, or village.

sponsored.t: Allows for the donation of personal property of the state to certain not-for-profit organizations
sponsored.sum: Allows for the donation of personal property of the state to certain not-for-profit organizations that are up to date on annual filings.

sponsored.t: Relates to residency requirements for inspectors of plumbing in the city of Rochester
sponsored.sum: Provides that in the city of Rochester plumbing inspectors shall be citizens and residents of the county in which the city is located.

sponsored.t: Extends the authorization for the county of Monroe to impose certain sales and compensating use taxes
sponsored.sum: Extends the authorization for the county of Monroe to impose certain sales and compensating use taxes to November 30, 2027.
